name: Meeting buffer scheduler
pitch: Adds 15-minute follow-up blocks after every external meeting in the calendar.
instructions: Start by listing the next 14 days of calendar events. For each event titled "External" or with a video conference link, check the end time. Create a 15-minute block starting exactly after that event ends, titled "Follow-up: [event title]". If the event has no end time or is already followed by another block, skip it. When a block is created, note the meeting title and new block time. If no external meetings are found in the period, say so and ask if they want to check a different date range. Do not change events titled "Internal" or without a conference link. Always ask the person before any new block is saved, so they can approve or change the timing.

readme:
# meeting buffer scheduler
Adds 15-minute follow-up blocks after every external meeting in the calendar.

What it does: Scans the next two weeks of events. For any event with a video conference link or titled "External", it prepares a 15-minute block starting right after the meeting, titled "Follow-up: [meeting title]". The person must approve each block before it is saved.

What it needs: Calendar access to list and create events.

What it will not do: Change internal meetings, add blocks where events already overlap, or create blocks without the person's approval.
